scenes.hook: Your agent says it's done. But the cloud is still billing: a t3.large and a Postgres database, seventy-six dollars a month.
scenes.ask: Lights Out is a plugin for Hermes Agent. Before any AWS command that creates something billable, Hermes asks you first, with the price. Say no, and nothing is created.
scenes.keep: Some things should stay up, like a demo during judging. Hermes proposes a keep until that date, with the cost by then. Only you can approve it.
scenes.results: We measured it. Ten tasks, the same model, three ways. Hermes alone left fourteen resources running, two hundred and sixty-two dollars a month. A clean-up prompt cut that to one. With Lights Out, nothing billable started without a yes, and one command turned off all fourteen.
scenes.out: When you're finished, type lights out. It lists what it will turn off, asks once, and the receipt goes green. The demo server stays, kept on purpose.
scenes.end: Lights Out, for Hermes Agent. Done shouldn't mean still billing.
